## Hypothesis

Measure the current engine's performance on the OP-16 anchor days to establish baseline edge_capture and aggregate Sharpe. This provides the reference point against which all strategy candidates are evaluated per OP-16 scoring.

## Mechanism

The current engine operates under the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON playbook (v15.3 parameters) with chart-stop as primary invalidation, chandelier profit-lock arming at +5% and trailing 0.15, and standard TP1 at +50% (qty fraction 0.667). Entries require level rejection, EMA ribbon flip (fast < pivot < slow), and confluence with multi-day or premarket structure. Exits follow the playbook's scale-out and runner rules.
